name: Local Read
description: Read a document from the offline library by id, as returned by local_search. Long documents are paged: repeat the call with the offset printed at the end. Set export=true to deliver the full document to the user as a file instead.

id.description: Result id from local_search, copied exactly

offset.description: Continue reading from this character offset

path.description: The SAME 'path' passed to local_search — required whenever that search used one, because an id only resolves inside the folder that produced it (the search output prints the call to make)

images.description: Deliver the article's images to the user's chat. Default: automatic on the first page only (max 3); true forces them on any page, false disables

export.description: Deliver the FULL document to the user as a file (a ZIM article becomes a readable HTML page; PDFs, Office documents and text files go as the original file). Use when the user asks for the whole article or document. The tool prints only a confirmation — never paste the content yourself
